en: The postcard features a black-and-white/sepia photograph of a rural Swedish landscape, with fields, distant hills, and several traditional farmhouses. The prominent white building appears to be a significant residence or manor. In the foreground, dried haystacks are visible. There is handwritten cursive text over part of the image, and the words 'Holmbacken Ånge' are printed at the top, indicating the location. The reverse side carries postal information, addresses, and a Swedish 5 öre stamp with a portrait of King Oscar II, as well as multilingual instructions for use as a postcard.
